notes.title: September 9, 2025: The first closed beta test concluded successfully
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Our first closed beta test ran smoothly from August 23 to September 6, 2025.

We are currently sorting out and optimizing the issues everyone reported during the first test. Once we have made every aspect of "The Great Diamond Town" more polished and engaging, we will launch the second round of testing.

We truly appreciate your participation and feedback during this period!❤
